verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe users manually running an external agent (Claude Code or Codex) against their repo, but nowhere is there evidence of an internal 'automatic model selection' mechanism or a setting to override it with a specific model — the choice of agent is made outside Foreloop, not configured within it. missing for 10: any mention of a model-selection setting, an 'automatic' vs 'manual model' toggle, or documentation of choosing a specific underlying model.
